summary: Tested NEW broadcast feature (iteration 11): backend POST /api/admin/broadcast (auth/validation/503 correct-behavior), an isolated unit test mocking bot._bot_app for broadcast_message() logic, and full frontend UI/UX of the new broadcast section in ConfigPanel. All 12 backend tests and all frontend flows passed.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py POST /api/admin/broadcast: correctly validates empty message+file (400), enforces MAX_BROADCAST_FILE_BYTES=45MB (400), requires require_admin (401), and maps RuntimeError from broadcast_message to a clean 503 - all correct.

bot.py broadcast_message(): confirmed via mocked unit tests - (1) iterates all db.bot_users user_ids, (2) selects send_photo/send_video/send_document by content_type prefix correctly, (3) uploads file bytes only for first recipient and reuses returned file_id (obj[-1].file_id for photo array, obj.file_id for video/document) for the rest, (4) wraps each send in try/except so one failure doesn't abort the loop, (5) returns accurate {sent, failed, total}, (6) has asyncio.sleep(0.05) between sends. No issues found in the logic.

Minor note (not a bug, just an observation): file.read() loads the entire upload into memory before the 45MB size check - for a 45MB file this is acceptable but worth knowing if the limit is ever raised significantly.
Good UX: on broadcast error, message text and file selection are correctly NOT cleared (verified in test - textarea retained value after 503), so admin doesn't lose their draft.
503 behavior in this preview environment (BOT_POLLING_ENABLED=false, _bot_app is None) is confirmed correct-by-design, not a bug, per instructions - matched expected detail message exactly.
test_credentials: Admin PIN 246810 (from /app/memory/test_credentials.md) - confirmed still working, unchanged, not modified during this test run.
seed_data_creation: None persisted - unit test used monkeypatched fake db collection (no real DB writes) to avoid Motor event-loop-per-test issues with pytest-xdist/asyncio.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Iteration 11 (broadcast feature) fully verified: (1) backend auth/validation/503 boundary tests in test_broadcast.py - 6/6 pass, (2) isolated unit test in test_broadcast_unit.py mocking bot._bot_app - 6/6 pass, verifying file_id reuse, media-type routing, per-recipient exception isolation, and accurate sent/failed/total counts, (3) frontend: unlock->broadcast section visible, send button disabled/enabled logic correct, file attach (via file chooser) shows filename chip, remove button clears it and re-disables send, clicking send with only a message shows the exact expected 503 error text and does NOT clear the textarea. Added pytest-asyncio to backend/requirements.txt (was missing, needed for async unit tests) - installed and verified compatible with the existing pytest.ini -n 2 --dist loadscope xdist config. No regressions found in config-save/change-pin buttons (verified present and functional from screenshot, not exercised the actual PIN change per instructions to avoid altering test credentials). No bugs found in this iteration.
